featured_reviews.review_text:
At 65, I finally gathered the courage to pursue a childhood dream I had carried in my heart for decades; to learn how to sing. Joining Ajivasan Music Academy has truly been a life-changing experience for me.

The environment here is warm, encouraging, and deeply inspiring. The teachers are not only skilled but also incredibly patient and supportive, making learning enjoyable at every step. They understand that passion has no age, and that belief reflects in the way they guide and nurture each student.

Another wonderful aspect is that the training is very affordable, making it accessible to everyone regardless of their social stature, without compromising on quality. The support staff is also extremely kind, helpful, and always ready to assist with a smile.

This academy has given wings to a dream I had almost forgotten. It has filled my days with joy, confidence, and a renewed sense of purpose. I am truly grateful to be part of this esteemed music academy under the able guidance of Padma Shri Suresh Wadkar ji and his better half Padma Wadkar Ma'am.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Can anyone imagine setting off to take up a graduation course in Hindustani Shaastriya Sangeet at the ripe old age of 68 !?! Soon I discovered Nehal ma'am to be a hard task master, a disciplinarian, a stickler for perfection. Yet I persevered & continued my journey with zeal; & I soon found my foothold in the Academy. With time, I had to inevitably accept my ma'am to be a tough protector, having a tough exterior with genuine empathy underneath.
My goal is years away, but today, at 72, I know I'm here to stay; I'm here, despite my recurrent absenteeism due to age related health challenges... yet striving happily through my 5th year to make my dreams come true.
Only you could make this happen @Ajivasan Academy, under the mentorship of Ms Nehal, your trusted teacher, who could hone my faculties thus. 🙏🙏
